title: Tech Note: 4D Write, Programming Styles, and Entry Control

historical_commentary.text: The classic 4D Write plug-in referenced here has been succeeded by 4D Write Pro, which offers a substantially different, more modern document and styling model, making this note's specific techniques obsolete for current 4D document development, though the general goal of controlled, style-driven data entry remains a valid application design pattern.
related_updates: 4D Write has been succeeded by 4D Write Pro, which uses a different, more modern document/formatting model than the classic 4D Write plug-in described here
